name: Rusutsu (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Rusutsu village emblem in white: a five-armed device of paired strokes radiating from a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Rusutsu, a village in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 2 September 1967.

features.role: Rusutsu village emblem — a five-armed device of paired strokes radiating from a ring
